[NERR.7.1] **`DS_ERR_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE` is the most common pump-time error
during setup** — a rule's RHS issued a `call` with no call callback
registered. (The cache verbs are exempt: `cached()` reads the
engine's own map and `cache` / `cache_delete` fall back to a volatile in-engine
cache when no persistence hook is wired, [NSTG.2].) Register the callback
*before* loading rules that use the verb ([NCBK.12]).
